q: What are custom die cut stickers?
a: Stickers printed with your artwork and cut along its outline instead of into a square or circle, so a logo arrives shaped like the logo. We print them on vinyl, paper, clear, holographic and specialty films, with gloss, matte or spot UV finishes, from 0.5 inch up to 24 by 36 inches.

q: How much do custom die cut stickers cost?
a: Prices start at $0.30 per sticker and fall as quantity rises and size shrinks. A 3-inch vinyl logo at 250 pieces is a typical mid-range order. The exact figure depends on material, size, finish and quantity, so every order is quoted individually, usually within one business day.

q: Is there a minimum order for die cut stickers?
a: Yes, 100 stickers per design and size. Below that the setup cost per piece gets unreasonable. If you need several designs, each one is its own 100-piece run, though they can share one proof and one shipment.

q: How long does an order take from quote to delivery?
a: Production takes 5 to 7 business days after you approve the free digital proof, and FedEx delivery brings the total to 8 to 10 business days for most US addresses. Rush production is available on request if a deadline is tighter than that.

q: Do you ship die cut stickers for free?
a: Yes, shipping within the United States is included in every quote. Orders go out by FedEx with tracking. International shipping can be arranged, and we quote it separately because rates vary by destination and weight.

q: What artwork do I need to send for die cut stickers?
a: A vector file (PDF, AI, EPS or SVG) is best because the cut line follows its outline exactly. A 300 dpi PNG or JPG with a transparent or plain background also works; we trace the outline and show it on the proof. Free design support covers fixes and simple layouts.

q: Will I see a proof before my stickers are printed?
a: Always. Every order gets a free digital proof showing the artwork at size with the cut line drawn in. Nothing prints until you approve it, and changes at the proof stage are free. Most customers approve within a day and production starts the same day.

q: Which sticker material should I choose for outdoor use?
a: Laminated white vinyl with a permanent adhesive. It handles rain, sun, pressure washing and freezing for three to five years on vertical surfaces. Paper and kraft are indoor-only. If the sticker lives on a vehicle or outside for years, ask for cast vinyl.

q: Can you print die cut stickers in small sizes?
a: Down to about 0.5 inch for a plain shape and 0.75 inch for anything with readable text. Small sizes usually ship on sheets or rolls so they are easy to peel. Type below 6 point should be bold and strokes thicker than 1 point.

q: Can I order different designs in one order?
a: Yes. Each design is its own 100-piece run with its own price line, but they share one proof round and ship together. Many customers order a logo sticker, a packaging seal and a promotional sticker at the same time to save on shipping and admin.
